docs.title: Command line
docs.text: Every command-line option. Global options come before the command: wambatic -v report .... python -m wambatic runs the same program.

docs.title: Global options
docs.text: Option Default Meaning -v, --verbose off Log debugging detail, with time and source location -q, --quiet off Log warnings and errors only; cannot be used with -v -h, --help Show the help and exit --completion generate\|complete Print the shell completion source (generate), or complete a command line (complete)

docs.title: report
docs.text:
wambatic report TARGET [options] prints a report of a user, an organisation or a repository.

Option Default Meaning TARGET required user:NAME, org:NAME, repo:OWNER/NAME, OWNER/NAME or a bare NAME --format terminal\|html\|json report.format The output format --out PATH report.out_dir With --format html, the file to write, or an existing directory to write the report into; an error with another format --by year\|month\|week\|day\|total month The period to bucket by; weeks are ISO weeks starting on Monday. With --format html, the period shown when the page opens, and total is an error --since YYYY-MM-DD the first commit First day, inclusive, in the report time zone; not before 2008-01-01 --until YYYY-MM-DD today Last day, inclusive, in the report time zone; not after tomorrow in that zone --groups NAMES activity,flow Comma-separated metric groups: activity, delivery, flow, popularity. delivery and popularity are off by default because they read every workflow run, star and fork, which costs requests --by-author off Break activity down by author; not for a user target --tz ZONE stats.timezone An IANA time zone such as Europe/Berlin --commit-tz report\|author stats.commit_timezone report dates every commit in the report zone; author dates each commit in its author's zone --full-refresh off Read all history again and ignore --max-age; cannot be used with --no-fetch --no-fetch off Use the cache only, with no network and no token --max-age DURATION fetch.max_age Skip the network when every resource was synced more recently, for example 30m or 1d --ignore-cache-version off Read a cache written by a different wambatic or schema version, and say so in the report --github-host HOST fetch.github_host The GitHub Enterprise Server host to read, such as ghe.example.com, or github.com; it also picks that host's cache file

Dates must be written YYYY-MM-DD; other ISO forms are rejected. Without --no-fetch and --max-age, every run syncs first, because fetch.max_age defaults to zero.

docs.title: serve
docs.text:
wambatic serve [TARGET] [options] runs the web app, on this machine only unless told otherwise.

Option Default Meaning TARGET none Optional. Fills in the form and names the first report URL; a malformed target is an error before the server starts --host ADDRESS report.web_host The address to listen on. Only localhost and loopback addresses are accepted without --allow-remote; no name is looked up, so use 127.0.0.1 or ::1 --port PORT report.web_port The port, from 1 to 65535 --allow-remote report.allow_remote Listen on an address other than loopback, and turn off the Host check; logs a warning --max-age DURATION fetch.max_age As for report --ignore-cache-version off As for report --github-host HOST fetch.github_host As for report; unrelated to --host, the address to listen on

docs.title: cache
docs.text:
wambatic cache info|clear shows or removes the local cache. Neither uses the network.

Option Default Meaning ACTION required info describes the cache, including its github_host and server_version; clear removes it and its -wal and -shm files without asking --github-host HOST fetch.github_host Act on that host's cache file

docs.title: Exit statuses
docs.text:
What each exit status means.

Status Meaning 0 Success, and --help 1 A GitHub or cache error (no token, a missing user or repository, the rate limit, a cache from another version, a CacheHostError for a cache made for another host, a ServerVersionError for an Enterprise server that is too old or reports no version, a GitError when git is missing or older than 2.40, a command fails or times out, or its output cannot be read, a BranchesMismatchError when fetch.branches has changed since the commits were synced and the report would not sync again), a report error (nothing to report, an unknown group, a range that ends before it starts), an HTML report that cannot be written to its path, a port that serve cannot listen on, or an unexpected error, which is logged with its traceback 2 A command line that cannot be run: an unknown option, a malformed target or date, a clash such as --full-refresh with --no-fetch, a bad config file or setting, or serve asked to listen on an address other than loopback without --allow-remote or on a port outside 1 to 65535 130 Interrupted with Ctrl-C, including a stopped serve

Each failure prints one line to stderr that says what to do. Reports go to stdout and logs to stderr, so --format json can be piped; if the reader of a pipe goes away (| head), wambatic ends quietly with status 1.

docs.title: Metrics
docs.text: Every metric, with its group, unit and definition. Each event is placed in the period of its own date in the report time zone. p50 is the median and p90 the 90th percentile of the values in the period; a period with no value has no point (the terminal shows -), because a median of nothing is not zero.

docs.title: Groups
docs.text: Group Default Meaning activity yes Commits, contributors and lines delivery no Workflow runs, releases and the DORA proxies flow yes Pull requests and issues popularity no Stars and forks, with watchers and languages as snapshots

docs.title: Metrics table
docs.text: Metric Group Unit Definition commits activity count Commits on the default branch in the period; merge commits count as commits but add no lines contributors activity count Distinct commit authors in the period, leaving out stats.bot_logins active_days activity days Days in the period with at least one commit lines_added activity lines Lines added by the commits in the period lines_deleted activity lines Lines deleted by the commits in the period lines_net activity lines Lines added minus lines deleted prs_opened flow count Pull requests created in the period prs_merged flow count Pull requests merged in the period; one closed without merging counts only in prs_opened issues_opened flow count Issues created in the period issues_closed flow count Issues closed in the period and still closed; a reopened issue is open time_to_first_review_p50 flow hours Median hours from a pull request being opened to its first review, by the date of the review. Reviews by the pull request's author and by bots are left out time_to_first_review_p90 flow hours The 90th percentile of the same time_to_merge_p50 flow hours Median hours from a pull request being opened to being merged, by the date of the merge time_to_merge_p90 flow hours The 90th percentile of the same time_to_close_p50 flow hours Median hours from an issue being opened to being closed, by the date of the close time_to_close_p90 flow hours The 90th percentile of the same pr_size_p50 flow lines The median of added plus deleted lines over the pull requests merged in the period workflow_runs delivery count Workflow runs created in the period, whatever their state workflow_success_rate delivery ratio Of the completed runs created in the period whose conclusion is success, failure, timed out or startup failure, the share that succeeded; cancelled and skipped runs are left out. Shown as a percentage workflow_duration_p50 delivery minutes Median minutes from a completed run starting to its last update; an approximation, since GitHub does not report a run's end time workflow_duration_p90 delivery minutes The 90th percentile of the same release_count delivery count Releases published in the period, prereleases included, drafts left out release_interval_p50 delivery days The median whole days since the repository's previous release, for the releases published in the period; a repository's first release has none deployments delivery count A release that is not a prerelease, at the time it was published. With stats.deploy_workflow set, a successful, completed run of that workflow, at the time the run finished. Counted for each repository lead_time_p50 delivery hours Median hours from a merged pull request's first commit (its creation, when that is not known) to the first deployment of the same repository at or after the merge, in the period of the deployment. A pull request that no deployment has followed yet is not counted lead_time_p90 delivery hours The 90th percentile of the same change_failure_rate delivery ratio Of the deployments in the period, the share followed, within stats.failure_window, by a pull request of the same repository that carries a label in stats.hotfix_labels. A deployment whose window is still open at the end of the range counts as not failed. Shown as a percentage time_to_restore_p50 delivery hours Median hours from a hotfix pull request being opened to being merged, in the period of the merge time_to_restore_p90 delivery hours The 90th percentile of the same stars_added popularity count Stars given in the period, by the date they were given stars_total popularity count The stars that exist now, counted by when they were given, up to the end of the period forks_added popularity count Direct forks made in the period, by the date they were made forks_total popularity count The forks that exist now, counted by when they were made, up to the end of the period

docs.title: Settings
docs.text:
Every setting, with its default and type. Settings are layered, and a later layer wins: built-in defaults, then the JSON file ~/.config/wambatic/config.json, then command line flags. Set WAMBATIC_CONFIG to use another file. The token is not a setting.

A duration is a whole number and one unit, s, m, h, d or w, such as 30d. A leading ~ in a path is expanded.

docs.title: Settings table
docs.text: Setting Type Default Meaning and trade-off fetch.api_history totals or files totals How a repository that is not cloned is read: totals reads the default branch with per-commit totals; files also reads each commit's files, one request per commit, and follows fetch.branches fetch.branches list of strings [] Branch name patterns (shell wildcards) followed beside the default branch by a clone and by api_history files; empty follows the default branch only, ["*"] every branch fetch.cache_path path or none none Where the cache lives; unset uses ~/.cache/wambatic/cache.sqlite3 for github.com and ~/.cache/wambatic/cache-<host>.sqlite3 for another host, so each host has its own cache fetch.clone_dir path or none none Where bare clones are kept; unset puts them in a clones directory beside the cache file, in a subdirectory named for the cache file fetch.clone_repos list of strings [] owner/name patterns (shell wildcards) of private or internal repositories you allow to be cloned; public repositories are cloned without it fetch.full_refresh_after duration 30d Age of the last full read after which a resource is read in full again to catch deletions; shorter is more accurate and costs more requests fetch.github_host host name github.com The GitHub host to read: github.com, or the host name of a GitHub Enterprise Server with an optional :port; lower-cased on load. api.github.com and *.ghe.com (data residency) are refused fetch.include_archived boolean false Include archived repositories of a user or organisation fetch.include_forks boolean false Include forks of a user or organisation fetch.max_age duration 0s Skip the network when the subject was synced more recently than this; zero always syncs fetch.max_retries integer 5 Retries for transient and secondary-limit errors fetch.on_rate_limit wait or fail wait wait sleeps until the limit resets, fail stops with an error that gives the reset time fetch.overlap duration 1h Safety margin subtracted from the watermark so a late arrival is not missed fetch.stats_retries integer 6 Retries while a REST statistics endpoint is still computing fetch.workers integer 4 Repositories fetched at once; more is faster and closer to GitHub's secondary limits report.allow_remote boolean false Let serve listen on an address other than loopback; anyone who can reach the port then acts with your token report.format terminal, html or json terminal The default output format report.html_theme auto, dark or light auto The HTML report's colours: auto follows the viewer's system setting, light and dark are fixed report.out_dir path ./wambatic-reports The directory the HTML report is written to when --out is absent report.web_host string 127.0.0.1 The address serve listens on report.web_port integer 8000 The port serve listens on stats.author_timezones object of strings {} Login to IANA zone ({"octocat": "Europe/London"}), compared without regard to case; in author mode it overrides a commit's recorded offset and dates the commits of a repository that records none; an unknown zone is an error stats.bot_logins list of strings ["dependabot[bot]", "renovate[bot]"] Authors left out of contributor counts and the top-contributors table stats.commit_timezone report or author report report dates every commit in the report zone (--tz, stats.timezone); author dates each commit in its author's zone, which changes active_days and the daily buckets for authors far from the report zone stats.deploy_workflow string or none none The workflow whose successful runs are the deployments, matched against a run's workflow file name (deploy.yml) or its name; unset, releases that are not prereleases are the deployments stats.exclude_merge_commits boolean true Leave merge commits out of line counts stats.exclude_paths list of strings ["**/*.lock", "**/package-lock.json", "**/pnpm-lock.yaml", "**/go.sum", "**/vendor/**", "**/node_modules/**", "**/dist/**", "**/*.min.js", "**/*.min.css", "**/*.map"] Path patterns whose files are left out of line counts stats.failure_window duration 7d How long after a deployment a hotfix pull request marks it as failed stats.hotfix_labels list of strings ["hotfix"] Pull request labels that mark a failure fix, compared without regard to case stats.linguist boolean true Also leave out files a repository marks linguist-generated or linguist-vendored in .gitattributes stats.timezone string UTC The zone used when --tz is absent; an unknown zone is an error
